items.text: No searching for an unfamiliar medical facility across the city. Care is already where you are staying.

sections.heading: What We Can Treat On-Site

items.title: Urgent Medical Care
items.text: Sudden illness, fever, infections, stomach and gut problems, dehydration, breathing problems and other urgent conditions.

items.title: Injuries & Minor Procedures
items.text: Wounds, burns, sprains and minor trauma, with dressings, stitches and other minor procedures where clinically appropriate.

items.title: Diagnostics & Laboratory Tests
items.text: Medical assessment with laboratory tests and diagnostic services when required.

items.title: IV Therapy & Medication
items.text: Doctor-prescribed medication, injections and IV therapy when medically indicated.

items.title: Specialist Consultation
items.text: Access to specialist physicians when further medical assessment is required.

items.title: Hotel Room Doctor Visit
items.text: When appropriate, a doctor comes directly to your hotel room.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
body: Quick answers before you message us.

items.title: Is there a 24/7 Clinic inside my hotel?
items.text: Use the Find a Clinic page or contact us on WhatsApp and send your hotel name.

items.title: What should I send you on WhatsApp?
items.text: Please send your name, hotel, location, brief description of the medical problem and insurance information if available.

items.title: Do I need to contact my insurance company first?
items.text: Not always. Send us your insurance details and our team can advise you on the next step.

items.title: Can you arrange an ambulance?
items.text: Yes. If ambulance transport is medically necessary, our team can coordinate it.

items.title: Can you provide documentation for my insurance?
items.text: Yes. Medical reports, invoices and other required documentation can be provided according to the case and insurer requirements.

items.title: What if my hotel does not have a 24/7 Clinic?
items.text: Contact our coordination team on WhatsApp and we will advise you about the nearest available medical solution.
